title: AppInputs
description: Resolved inputs file for fs-forge app plan and fs-forge app apply.

org.title: Organization
org.description: GitHub organization name. Optional when resolved from CLI context.

service.title: Service
service.description: Source code repository and release settings for the application's service.

release_type.title: Release Type
release_type.description: Release-please release type for the service.

service_names.title: Service Names
service_names.description: Optional override for service names in apps/<app>.yaml and make_dispatches.yaml. Defaults to [<service.repo>].

items.title: Deployment Target
items.description: A single (platform, tenant, env) deployment target.

cluster_url.title: Cluster URL
cluster_url.description: Confirmed Kubernetes cluster API server URL for ArgoCD.

track.title: Track
track.description: Build track that this deployment target receives.

flavor.title: Flavor
flavor.description: Optional build flavor override for make_dispatches.yaml. Defaults to default.

chart.title: Chart
chart.description: Helm chart reference for the application.

slack_channel.title: Slack Channel
slack_channel.description: Optional confirmed Slack notification channel for ArgoCD AppProject annotations.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Optional owner override used when services of the app disagree.

system.title: System
system.description: Optional system override used when services of the app disagree.
